where: Cofinality.lean, Exponential.lean, Family.lean, FixedPoint.lean, Veblen.lean: IsNormal.cof_eq, IsNormal.nfp_fp, iSup_pow, iSup_add_nat, ...
why: Many lemmas are renamed or moved out of the IsNormal namespace; old names are kept as deprecated aliases.

where: Arithmetic.lean and Family.lean: Ordinal.IsNormal.strictMono, lt_iff, le_iff, inj, id_le, map_iSup, map_sSup, refl, trans
why: Ordinal.IsNormal lemmas superseded by general Order.IsNormal/StrictMono API are deprecated to those counterparts.

where: Arithmetic.lean: IsNormal.le_iff_eq -> StrictMono.le_apply, IsNormal.le_set -> map_isLUB, IsNormal.monotone -> Order.IsNormal.strictMono
why: Several deprecations point to replacements that state a different result from the deprecated lemma.

where: Arithmetic.lean, Family.lean, FixedPoint.lean: @[deprecated X (since := ...)] on IsNormal.* lemmas and fp_iff_deriv
why: Each deprecation names a replacement, many of which are not drop-in substitutes (different form or extra steps).

where: Arithmetic.lean, Family.lean: deprecated IsNormal.limit_le, limit_lt, le_set, map_iSup_of_bddAbove, ...
why: Deprecated declarations whose replacement statement differs keep their own statements and proofs rather than becoming aliases.

where: Arithmetic.lean: IsNormal.le_set (new 3-line proof), le_set', inj, le_iff; Family.lean deprecated map_* lemmas
why: Deprecated lemmas keep or receive non-trivial proofs instead of one-line derivations from their replacements.

where: Arithmetic.lean, Family.lean: set_option linter.deprecated false in, before each deprecated IsNormal.* lemma
why: The linter is switched off repeatedly to silence warnings from statements still mentioning the deprecated Ordinal.IsNormal.

where: Ordinal.IsNormal def and its lemmas versus Order.IsNormal and its lemmas
why: Two parallel APIs state the same results; the Ordinal copy is deprecated in favour of Order's.

where: cof_eq_of_isNormal, cof_le_of_isNormal, isFundamentalSequence_of_isNormal, apply_omega0_of_isNormal, nfp_fp, deriv_fp, apply_lt_nfp, ...
why: Lemmas whose main hypothesis is IsNormal f are moved out of the IsNormal namespace, losing dot notation.

where: cof_eq_of_isNormal, apply_omega0_of_isNormal, isFundamentalSequence_of_isNormal versus nfp_fp, deriv_fp, apply_lt_nfp
why: Renamed lemmas include the hypothesis as _of_isNormal in some names and omit it in others.

where: Renamed lemmas across Cofinality.lean, Family.lean, FixedPoint.lean, Veblen.lean
why: Sibling lemmas leaving the IsNormal namespace get inconsistent naming patterns (with/without _of_isNormal, _iff).

where: Cofinality.lean: cof_eq_of_isNormal; Family.lean: apply_omega0_of_isNormal
why: New equation lemma names: bare cof_eq naming no right side; apply_omega0 names the right-hand side.

where: All new @[deprecated (since := ...)] attributes; FixedPoint.lean uses 2025-10-25 where others use 2025-12-25
why: Dozens of deprecations record dates in since, with inconsistent dates across the PR.

where: Exponential.lean: opow_add, opow_mul proof rewrites, module docstring reflow; iSup_*_nat renames
why: Proof golfs, docstring reformatting and renames not required by the IsNormal deprecation are included.

where: Exponential.lean, FixedPoint.lean, Principal.lean call sites: .strictMono.le_apply.ge_iff_eq', .strictMono.injective.eq_iff
why: Deprecating shortcuts like le_iff_eq, inj, le_apply lengthens many dependent proofs without replacement lemmas.

where: Arithmetic.lean and FixedPoint.lean module docstrings
why: Module docstrings are edited to reflect Order.IsNormal and the changed forms of fixed-point statements.

where: Arithmetic.lean: docstring of Ordinal.IsNormal (Todo removed); removed section header
why: A TODO 'deprecate this in favor of Order.IsNormal' is removed as the PR does it.

where: Arithmetic.lean: protected def IsNormal; Order/IsNormal.lean: protected theorem monotone
why: Declarations made protected to avoid clashing with Order.IsNormal and root Monotone names when namespaces open.

where: Exponential.lean: iSup_pow_natCast; Family.lean: iSup_add_natCast, iSup_mul_natCast, apply_omega0_of_isNormal
why: Lemmas renamed so names spell statement declarations (natCast for Nat.cast, isNormal).

where: Family.lean: alias IsNormal.apply_of_isLimit retargeted to Order.IsNormal.apply_of_isSuccLimit
why: An existing deprecated alias is retargeted when its target is itself deprecated.

where: Whole PR: IsNormal deprecation mixed with natCast renames, opow proof golfs, FixedPoint renames
why: Separable changes are bundled into one large deprecation PR across eleven files.

where: Family.lean, Topology.lean: Order.IsNormal.map_iSup H ..., Order.IsNormal.map_sSup H ...; Cofinality call sites
why: Call sites switch from dot notation to fully qualified names applied to IsNormal hypotheses.

where: PR description: 'See issue #17033. Moved from #28743.'
why: Description does not state the many renames, moved lemmas or deprecation targets the PR makes.

where: Exponential.lean: opow_add, opow_mul (obtain ... ; · simp)
why: New proof lines put two tactics on one line with ';'.

where: Exponential.lean: opow_add, have : b + c ≠ 0 then exact of the same term
why: Rewritten proof introduces a have that the following steps do not use.
